task: Cover the sprint board (`/`): three columns, seven seeded cards (four in Todo, two in In progress, one in Done). A card can be moved to another column by dragging it onto that column or with its Move menu, and it then appears in the new column only; each column heading shows its card count in parentheses. In progress holds at most three cards: moving a fourth there is refused with `In progress is full (limit 3)` and the card stays in its column. Moves are stored on the server, so a reload shows the same board.
